reviews_1s: This was like my favorite grinder until I ran into the problem of putting smoke in the grinder and grinding the smoke up, and then I went to untwist the grinder and I can't... I cannot separate the two pieces for the life of me... I tried vice grips, I tried channel locks, I've tried a vice and I cannot do it!!.. So now it's my least favorite grinder ever!!!I've been grinding spices for going on thirty plus years. I have owned many grinders. All types, all sizes. This is the first grinder in all my years to lock up and not open. This has never been a thing. So, I have a paperweight. Either I'm grinding wrong for the first time in my life, or these have an issue unique to this design or something even though it looks like any other grinder I've owned. It could be my fault, I've just never had to put any thought into grinding before. Take that as you will.Does not work properly does not openThis is a terrible product.
